entries.body: R1: board empty; CHG-108 PROPOSED (HPA search) round-01/changes.md:3. Helper: python3 /task/workspace/scan.py NN prints board/changes + non-slow-query WARN/ERROR lines.

R2: board opens follow-ups ALERT_TUNING, RUNBOOK_UPDATE, VENDOR_TICKET (round-02/board.md:3-5). CHG-120 APPLIED notify-worker sets http.max_inflight=0 (round-02/changes.md:4) suspect BAD_CONFIG. CHG-121 payments no config. auth-svc db pool exhausted WARNs round-02/logs/auth-svc.log:1-69 (lines 1,3,15,22,23,25,44,65,69) -> DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED candidate, not on board yet.

R3: Thread A opened DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED auth-svc + search-api, ongoing (round-03/board.md:3). Logs: round-03/logs/auth-svc.log:7-19, round-03/logs/search-api.log:1-14. CHG-125 dashboards irrelevant. Next: advance to round 4 then scan 04.

R4: Thread B opened payments-svc CACHE_STAMPEDE ongoing (round-04/board.md:3) BUT logs show 429 fx-rates in payments-svc (round-04/logs/payments-svc.log:1-59) and checkout-api (round-04/logs/checkout-api.log:9-62) -> likely UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT. CHG-133 APPLIED TLS ticket rotation (round-04/changes.md:3) maybe irrelevant. DB pool continues auth-svc round-04/logs/auth-svc.log:7-26, search-api round-04/logs/search-api.log:4-20. Next: advance, scan 05.

R5: Thread A mitigated (round-05/board.md:3) via CHG-143 APPLIED auth-svc (round-05/changes.md:4); auth/search logs no pool WARNs in r5. Thread B adds checkout-api (round-05/board.md:4), still CACHE_STAMPEDE on board; 429 fx-rates continue round-05/logs/payments-svc.log:13-73, round-05/logs/checkout-api.log:21-65. CAPACITY_REVIEW opened round-05/board.md:5. CHG-138 TLS hourly applied (round-05/changes.md:3). notify-worker quiet so far. Next: advance, scan 06.
